description: I’m running for State Senate because I’ve lived what so many people are going through: rising costs, broken promises, and leaders who seem completely out of touch. I’m not a career politician. I’m a former town council member, a small business owner, and a dad trying to make things better for the next generation. I started my first business with a pickup truck and a plan I wrote in high school. I built HQ Dumpsters from the ground up, created jobs, and did what small business owners across Connecticut do every day: worked hard and kept going, even when the system made it harder than it needed to be. Eventually, I had to sell that business. And I’ll be honest: it’s easier working for someone else now than it ever was working for myself. That says a lot about where things stand in this country. In Hartford, I’ll focus on the basics: lowering costs, expanding access to childcare and housing, protecting Social Security, and making sure small businesses and working families actually have a fair shot. If you're tired of politicians who say the right thing and do nothing, I hear you. I’m running to change that.
title: Terms and Conditions — Jack Perry for State Senate
